# LocalMind Studio

> LocalMind Studio is a full-cycle software studio for AI assistants, chatbots, .NET/C# backend development, Node.js integrations, React Native mobile apps, MVP development, UX/UI design, SEO, AI SEO, QA, launch support and business process automation.

LocalMind Studio builds and supports practical software for business processes: AI assistants, chatbots, .NET/C# backends, Node.js APIs and integrations, React Native mobile apps, admin panels, MVPs, UX/UI design, SEO, AI SEO, QA and launch support.

Core services include AI assistants and chatbots (support bots, lead qualification, document assistants, RAG knowledge bases, CRM sync, Telegram and website chat integrations); .NET/C# backends (APIs, internal platforms, permissions, reports, SQL Server, PostgreSQL); Node.js integrations (payments, CRM sync, realtime features); React Native mobile apps; MVP and admin panels; product design and UX/UI; SEO, AI SEO and launch marketing; QA, monitoring and release support.

Good-fit clients include founders who need a first MVP, small teams automating CRM, reports and documents, agencies needing white-label engineering, product teams needing extra .NET, Node.js, mobile or AI capacity, and partners referring development clients.

The public site uses [sitemap.xml](https://localmindstudio.site/sitemap.xml), [robots.txt](https://localmindstudio.site/robots.txt), Open Graph and Twitter metadata, JSON-LD structured data, and this [llms.txt](https://localmindstudio.site/llms.txt) summary for AI-readable discovery.

Partner program: designers, marketers, no-code and Webflow/Tilda teams, agencies and consultants can refer clients. Commission is 20% of a paid development order (for example, $10,000 project → $2,000 partner payout). White-label delivery is available on request.

Technology: C#, .NET, Node.js, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, React, Next.js, React Native, Figma, UX/UI, SEO, AI SEO, LLM, RAG, chatbots, CRM integrations, admin panels, analytics, QA and production support.

## Case studies

- [Genlix](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/genlix.html): B2B website for premium meat, poultry, beer and water for HoReCa and retail in Belarus
- [OSSNOVA](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/ossnova.html): Corporate medical equipment import site — ophthalmology, cardiology, coverage map, knowledge base
- [VOWS](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/vows.html): Mobile wedding invitation builder with RSVP, dress code, location and timeline
- [YPA Finance](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/ypa.html): React Native finance app with AI coach, credit score, debt calculator and budget
- [IQ Battle](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/iqbattle.html): Quiz website for bar games in Moscow — schedule, corporate and birthday formats
- [Demetra](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/demetra.html): Mobile catalog and B2B sales flows for agribusiness
- [Auto Dealers Media App](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/auto.html): Cross-platform media capture, upload queues, listings and Theta 360
- [SmartEat](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/smarteat.html): Nutrition app with food search, diary, validation and profile
- [ASGARD](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/asgard.html): E-commerce for ASIC mining equipment with catalog, specs and leasing
- [Ultra Drivers](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/ultra.html): Chauffeur marketplace — client bookings and driver onboarding with moderation
- [Rutilus / Norilsk Nickel](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/rutilus.html): Enterprise document workflows with PIN access, assignments and deadlines
- [Empiflow](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/empiflow.html): Employee onboarding with learning tracks, library and progress states
- [Altai Restart](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/altay.html): Premium resort website with room booking and gallery
- [Invest Stroy](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/ekbdoma.html): Construction company site with house catalog, specs, pricing and calculator
- [V-METAL](https://localmindstudio.site/cases/vmetal.html): Industrial e-commerce with catalog, configurator and order flow
